about: THE SINGLE SOURCE OF SHIPPING-VERIFICATION TRUTH (environment-separation PR-4).
Read by installer/ship-gate.ps1 (the protected installer's mechanical ship gate)
and by scripts/promotion-gate.sh (the dormant production-branch promotion gate).
Both enforce the same invariant: WHAT AURORA SHIPS MUST BE WHAT AURORA VERIFIED.
The deployedSuites inventory is drift-checked against .github/workflows on disk
by both consumers and by installer/test-ship-gate.ps1 in CI, so adding a suite
without recording it here fails loudly instead of silently shrinking the gate
(the exact failure the old hardcoded 13-suite list in promotion-gate.sh had).
frontendContextPaths mirrors the ctx_hash list in deployed-print-e2e.yml and
deploy-pages sensitivity; test-ship-gate.ps1 asserts the two stay equal.
